Portable Explosives & Narcotics Detector FC1800B

Sensitivity: 1ng TNT equivalent
Analysis Time: ≤ 2 seconds
Non-radioactive trace detection of explosives and narcotics; 2-second ultra-fast analysis; lightweight (<4kg) for superior individual mobility; comprehensive database for ICAO explosives and common narcotics; 800,000+ data storage capacity.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC1800B Portable Explosives and Narcotics Detector is our next-generation security instrument. Utilizing advanced photoionization high-resolution Ion Mobility Spectrometry (IMS) technology, it is entirely non-radioactive and poses zero radiation hazard to the human body. It features rapid detection, high sensitivity, low power consumption, and a compact, lightweight design for exceptional portability. Designed for ease of maintenance and high adaptability to various environments, it can accurately detect black powder, all explosives specified by ICAO, and a wide variety of narcotics simultaneously. With its dual-mode (positive/negative) capability, it provides nanogram-level identification and reports the specific names of detected substances, making it an ideal tool for rapid on-site inspections.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • Portable design for field and mobile inspection operations.
  • Ion Mobility Spectrometry (IMS) technology for high-sensitivity trace detection.
  • Detects a wide spectrum of explosives including TNT, RDX, PETN, C4, black powder, TATP, etc.
  • Detects common narcotics including methamphetamine, heroin, cocaine, ketamine, MDMA, etc.
  • Simultaneous dual-mode detection for both explosives and narcotics.
  • Detection sensitivity at nanogram (ng) level.
  • Rapid analysis completing within 8 seconds.
  • Built-in rechargeable lithium battery supporting over 4 hours of continuous field operation.
  • 7-inch touchscreen for intuitive operation.
  • Non-radioactive ion source, safe for operators.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
TechnologyNon-radioactive Photoionization High-Resolution IMS
SubstancesDual-mode detection for explosives (TNT, RDX, etc.) and narcotics (Heroin, Meth, etc.)
SensitivityNanogram (ng) level (1ng TNT)
Analysis Time≤ 2 seconds
SamplingTrace particle swiping or direct air sampling
Display2.8-inch TFT color touchscreen
Storage Capacity≥ 800,000 records with USB retrieval and export
Battery EnduranceWork time > 2h; Standby > 12h
Self-CalibrationAutomatic environmental adaptation and real-time failure diagnostics
Weight< 4.0 kg
Dimensions470mm * 170mm * 200mm
